$comment: An entry needs a reason a reviewer can check and a reviewBy date.
Past its reviewBy date the build fails, so an exception cannot be forgotten.
Removing the vulnerable dependency also requires removing its entry: a stale

acknowledged.reason: RSC Mode CSRF bypass. PARTHA is a client-only Vite SPA that mounts createBrowserRouter; React Router RSC mode is never enabled, so the vulnerable code path is not reachable. No fixed release exists at any version: 7.12.0-8.3.0 are affected and npm reports 'No fix available', while downgrading below 7.12.0 reintroduces the open-redirect advisories GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6 and GHSA-jjmj-jmhj-qwj2 that do affect this app. Upgraded to 7.18.1 to fix those two and accepted this one.
